title: Diagnóstico breve
intro: Diagnóstico breve (unos 25–35 minutos, puede hacerse en dos sesiones). Estima cada habilidad por separado y con su nivel de confianza. Si la muestra es pequeña, se pedirá más evidencia en vez de inventar una etiqueta precisa. No es una certificación.

resources.title: Abstract
resources.body: Small manufacturers often struggle to plan production when demand changes quickly. This study examines whether a simple rolling forecast improves weekly planning in small furniture workshops. We collected order and production data from 18 workshops over six months and compared planning error before and after the forecast was introduced. Planning error decreased in 13 of the 18 workshops. However, the effect was smaller in workshops with highly irregular orders. The results suggest that simple forecasting tools can support planning, although their benefit depends on demand patterns.

resources.title: Method paragraph
resources.body: Data were obtained from the workshops' order books and production records. Planning error was defined as the absolute difference between planned and actual weekly output, divided by actual output. Each workshop was observed for three months before and three months after the forecast was introduced.

options.text: The effect was smaller when orders were highly irregular.

activities.prompt: In the method paragraph, how is 'planning error' defined?

options.text: The number of late orders per week.
The absolute difference between planned and actual output, divided by actual output.

activities.prompt: Does the abstract claim that the forecast always improves planning?

options.text: Yes, it improved planning in every workshop.
No; the benefit depends on demand patterns.
